goal.original: Agents cannot dispatch a generation over Vision's HTTP API - add a generation.submit connector capability so an agent's submit lands as a real gallery card, the same path the PromptBox uses. Then: the agent should be able to run a generation with SPECIFIC settings (ratio, resolution, quality tier, turbo, style, model) that Fabio names, not just inherit whatever the open project happens to be set to. No UI reflection needed.

next_action.description: Read MPI-547's brief.md and plan.md first. Do the ede087b1 live-verification (see plan pending item 1) BEFORE writing any new code - it is the first checklist item and the fix it depends on. Then confirm with Fabio which of the 22 PromptBox controls are in v1 scope (plan.md has a recommendation: ratio, qualityTier, krea2Turbo/h3Turbo, styleSelect, stylization, batch, seed) before starting Phase 1's resolver extraction.

key_decisions: Per-generation parameters, NO persistence to the project's saved settings - an agent-set turbo/ratio must not leak into the user's next manual Cue
No UI reflection required - the PromptBox does not need to change to match an agent's settings (Fabio's explicit call, 2026-08-12)
Named params (ratio, quality, turbo...) over raw injection keys - raw injectionParams stays the escape hatch and always wins over resolved values
Do NOT reimplement ratio/tier resolution inside agentDispatch.js - extract into a module the PromptBox also uses, or the two drift the first time a model's ratio table changes

The connector relay must stay dumb: one job shape in, one result shape out. Media staging/job status/cancellation belong server-side in routes/connector.js where they survive dispatch ever moving off the renderer
Job delivery is single-subscriber (newest wins), never broadcast - fixed after two renderers each dispatched the same job in the live smoke
constraints: qualityTier lives in the SHARED bucket (project.shared[mediaType].ratioSelector.qualityTier) - a STALE copy also sits inside modelSettings[id] on real projects; reading it there sizes off the wrong tier (js/data/projectModel.js doc comment)

krea2_t2i_sfw.json bakes Input_Width/Input_Height (nodes 75/74 = 768/1344, authoring residue) - inject nothing and that wins silently, with no Width/Height recorded in the sidecar to explain it after the fact
getModelRatios(model.type, orientation, qualityTier) is the existing resolver to extract/share - js/utils/ratios.js
One renderer only when smoke-testing: a stray dev browser tab on :3000 is the NEWEST subscriber and steals the job from the Electron window

generationService.js already imports resolveControlDefaults FROM the PromptBox component - a service reaching into a component. Extending that coupling is the wrong direction; move resolvers toward js/data or js/utils instead

Every one of MPI-546's three live-found bugs returned ok:true from the API. For any change whose consumer is the UI, watch the real app before calling it done - see feedback_verify_ui_driving_apis_live.md
